description: "Life of Tecumseh, and of His Brother the Prophet" by Benjamin Drake is a historical account written in the early 19th century. The book focuses on the lives of Tecumseh and his brother, the Prophet, significant leaders among the Shawanoe Indians, examining their efforts to unite Native American tribes against encroaching white settlers.
